Messages.Author: Marc Gabriele
Messages.Body:
The situation:
Muaziz is attempting to Arson an Elysium. The Elysium's
controller, grumbling about minions with inherent stealth, declines to
block. Abd-Al Rashid then uses Mask of 1000 Faces (at inferior) to take
over the action.

Question 1: Does the action currently have +1 stealth or no stealth?
Question 2: If the action has no stealth, does the Elysium's controller
have another chance to declare blocking attempts?

Marc G.

Messages.Author: Lee Fent
Messages.Body:

Marc Gabriele <goo...@dementia.org> wrote:
>
> The situation:
> Muaziz is attempting to Arson an Elysium. The Elysium's
> controller, grumbling about minions with inherent stealth, declines to
> block. Abd-Al Rashid then uses Mask of 1000 Faces (at inferior) to
take
> over the action.
>
> Question 1: Does the action currently have +1 stealth or no stealth?

I would say no stealth. The +1 is inherent to Muaziz, just like a +1
bleed would be inherent with Ozmo.

> Question 2: If the action has no stealth, does the Elysium's
controller
> have another chance to declare blocking attempts?

I think the correct sequence is that any time an action modifier is
played, there is an option to play or react differently. So I'd say
yes, the action which is now at 0 stealth can be reacted to, or blocked
again.

> Question 2: If the action has no stealth, does the Elysium's controller

No. The decision not to block is final.
